lines.speaker: Chaz Brightley
lines.text: Win This Planet! The quiz where the questions are about you, and the answers are wrong!

lines.speaker: Chaz Brightley
lines.text: You're listening to Win This Planet, on one hundred point oh! Everybody's a winner! Nobody's won!

lines.speaker: The Announcer
lines.text: Win This Planet! Live from Studio Infinity!

lines.speaker: Doreen, the Studio Audience
lines.text: Woo.

lines.speaker: Chaz Brightley
lines.text: Nobody has ever won the planet. Tonight, that could change! It won't! But it could!

lines.speaker: Chaz Brightley
lines.text: Good evening, and welcome to Win This Planet! Live, before a studio audience of one!

lines.speaker: Chaz Brightley
lines.text: Thank you, Doreen!

lines.speaker: Chaz Brightley
lines.text: Doreen, you've been our studio audience for four hundred episodes! What keeps you coming back?

lines.speaker: Doreen, the Studio Audience
lines.text: I live here, Chaz. They built the studio around my house.

lines.speaker: Chaz Brightley
lines.text: And we are so glad they did! Doreen, everybody!

lines.speaker: Chaz Brightley
lines.text: It's Win This Moon! The daytime edition! Smaller prizes, smaller stakes, and the same three contestants, who live here now!

lines.speaker: Chaz Brightley
lines.text: Today's moon is a lovely little moon called Pebble! It's about the size of a large village. It has one crater, and the crater has a bench!

lines.speaker: Chaz Brightley
lines.text: Is that a moon you could love? It is! It is a moon you could love!

lines.speaker: Chaz Brightley
lines.text: Welcome to the Graveyard Round. We've turned the lights down. We've muffled the buzzer. The planet is asleep. Let's not wake it.

lines.speaker: Chaz Brightley
lines.text: A question for the operator on the relay ship. Yes, you. It's a hard one. Ready?

lines.speaker: Chaz Brightley
lines.text: What's your heading?

lines.speaker: Chaz Brightley
lines.text: No idea? That's all right. Nobody knows their heading at this hour. Ten points.

lines.speaker: Grandma Hester
lines.text: Chaz, I've fallen asleep at my podium.

lines.speaker: Chaz Brightley
lines.text: Hester, you're talking to me.

lines.speaker: Grandma Hester
lines.text: I talk in my sleep, dear.

lines.speaker: Grandma Hester
lines.text: Nineteen fifty two.

lines.speaker: Chaz Brightley
lines.text: Ten points to Hester.

lines.speaker: Chaz Brightley
lines.text: Fingers on buzzers! For four hundred points: what is your name?

lines.speaker: Chaz Brightley
lines.text: Next question! This one's about you, and only you: how old are you? Take your time! Don't take your time!

lines.speaker: Chaz Brightley
lines.text: For the planet! Where, exactly, do you live? You may confer! You may not use a map!

lines.speaker: Chaz Brightley
lines.text: Lightning round! What did you have for breakfast this morning? Buzzers ready!

lines.speaker: Chaz Brightley
lines.text: Here's a tricky one! What is your favourite colour? It's on the card! I can see it! Can you?

lines.speaker: Chaz Brightley
lines.text: For a thousand points and a moon! How many hands have you got? Show your working!

lines.speaker: Unit Seven
lines.text: Calculating. Calculating. The answer is: no.

lines.speaker: Chaz Brightley
lines.text: It wasn't a yes or no question, Unit Seven!

lines.speaker: Unit Seven
lines.text: Then the answer is: also no.

lines.speaker: Chaz Brightley
lines.text: That's minus two hundred, and a warning!

lines.speaker: Wendell, a Nervous Blob
lines.text: Is it, um, me? Is the answer me?

lines.speaker: Chaz Brightley
lines.text: So close, Wendell! The question's about you! The answer isn't you!

lines.speaker: Wendell, a Nervous Blob
lines.text: That's how I feel most days, Chaz.

lines.speaker: Chaz Brightley
lines.text: And that's the spirit we love on this show!

lines.speaker: Grandma Hester
lines.text: Nineteen fifty two.

lines.speaker: Chaz Brightley
lines.text: Hester, that's your answer to everything!

lines.speaker: Grandma Hester
lines.text: It was right once.

lines.speaker: Chaz Brightley
lines.text: It has never been right, Hester!

lines.speaker: Grandma Hester
lines.text: It was right in nineteen fifty two.

lines.speaker: Grandma Hester
lines.text: Is the answer on the card, dear?

lines.speaker: Chaz Brightley
lines.text: It is, Hester!

lines.speaker: Grandma Hester
lines.text: Then it's whatever's on the card.

lines.speaker: Chaz Brightley
lines.text: That's technically correct! Judges? The judges are conferring!

lines.speaker: Chaz Brightley
lines.text: The judges have confiscated the card!

lines.speaker: Chaz Brightley
lines.text: And Wendell's buzzed in already! Wendell, your answer?

lines.speaker: Wendell, a Nervous Blob
lines.text: I don't know. I panicked. The button was right there.

lines.speaker: Chaz Brightley
lines.text: The button is always right there, Wendell! That's what buttons do!

lines.speaker: Wendell, a Nervous Blob
lines.text: It's a lot of pressure, Chaz.

lines.speaker: Chaz Brightley
lines.text: No answer from our contestants! Let's go to the studio audience! Doreen?

lines.speaker: Doreen, the Studio Audience
lines.text: Is it a goose?

lines.speaker: Chaz Brightley
lines.text: It is not a goose, Doreen! It is never a goose! Lovely to have you, Doreen!

lines.speaker: Unit Seven
lines.text: Question requires knowledge of self. Searching. Searching.

lines.speaker: Unit Seven
lines.text: No self found.

lines.speaker: Chaz Brightley
lines.text: Oh, Unit Seven. That's a lot for a weeknight. We'll come back to you!

lines.speaker: Grandma Hester
lines.text: Can I phone a friend?

lines.speaker: Chaz Brightley
lines.text: There's no phoning a friend, Hester! This is Win This Planet!

lines.speaker: Grandma Hester
lines.text: I've already phoned her. She says, try the cupboard.

lines.speaker: Chaz Brightley
lines.text: That's not an answer, Hester, that's a place!

lines.speaker: Grandma Hester
lines.text: It's where she keeps the answers.

lines.speaker: Chaz Brightley
lines.text: The scores! Hester, minus twelve! Unit Seven, a rounding error! Wendell, unclear! The planet remains unwon!

lines.speaker: Chaz Brightley
lines.text: That's the round! Nobody has any points, so everybody's still in it! Don't go anywhere! The planet can't! It's a planet!

lines.speaker: Chaz Brightley
lines.text: Scores on the doors! Doreen is in the lead, and she isn't even playing! Take a bow, Doreen!

lines.speaker: Chaz Brightley
lines.text: And at the end of that round, the planet is still up for grabs! It always is! It's the one thing you can count on!

lines.speaker: Chaz Brightley
lines.text: Let's see what you could win! Announcer?

lines.speaker: The Announcer
lines.text: Tonight's planet is Varnell Four! Two moons, one careful previous owner, and an ocean that's mostly gravy! Comes with a weather system and a small, polite volcano!

lines.speaker: Chaz Brightley
lines.text: A polite volcano!

lines.speaker: The Announcer
lines.text: And if you don't win the planet, you'll go home with our consolation prize: a toaster that wins you another toaster!

lines.speaker: Chaz Brightley
lines.text: Hester has eleven of them!

lines.speaker: Grandma Hester
lines.text: Twelve. One of them won one in the car park.

lines.speaker: The Announcer
lines.text: Tonight's planet is Little Osk! A starter planet, perfect for first-time owners! One continent, no mortgage, and a single tree that everybody agrees is lovely!

lines.speaker: Chaz Brightley
lines.text: Everybody agrees! That never happens!

lines.speaker: Chaz Brightley
lines.text: People ask me, Chaz, has anyone ever won the planet? And I say: not yet! And they say, will anyone? And I say: not yet!

lines.speaker: Chaz Brightley
lines.text: And then they ask me to stop shouting, and I say: not yet!

lines.speaker: Chaz Brightley
lines.text: It's a spooky special! Welcome to Win This Haunted Planet!

lines.speaker: The Announcer
lines.text: Tonight's prize is Varnell Nine! Fully haunted, slightly damp, and very affordable, because nobody will go there!

lines.speaker: Chaz Brightley
lines.text: Not even Doreen! Doreen?

lines.speaker: Doreen, the Studio Audience
lines.text: Not even me, Chaz.

lines.speaker: Chaz Brightley
lines.text: Halloween round! Contestants, what have you come as?

lines.speaker: Unit Seven
lines.text: A robot.

lines.speaker: Chaz Brightley
lines.text: Unit Seven, you are a robot!

lines.speaker: Unit Seven
lines.text: Then it is a very good costume.

lines.speaker: Grandma Hester
lines.text: I've come as nineteen fifty two.

lines.speaker: Chaz Brightley
lines.text: Hester, that's correct! After four hundred episodes! Hester is correct!

lines.speaker: Grandma Hester
lines.text: I told you, dear. It was only ever a matter of time.

lines.speaker: Chaz Brightley
lines.text: Halloween week on Win This Planet, and this is the scariest question we've ever asked.

lines.speaker: Chaz Brightley
lines.text: Wendell. What are you afraid of?

lines.speaker: Wendell, a Nervous Blob
lines.text: This. Specifically this, Chaz.

lines.speaker: Chaz Brightley
lines.text: Wrong! The card says spiders! Ten points for honesty, though! We don't give points for honesty!
